theorems.statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → (∀ β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1 + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • (β (t • x)).curryLeft x)) → ∃ Φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1 + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1 + 1)) (x : Euclid P), ‖x‖ < ρ → (Φ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)) x = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1 + 1)) (t • x)).curryLeft x) ∧ ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1 + 1)) (b : ℝ), (∀ y, ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1 + 1)) y‖ ≤ b) → ∀ x, ‖(Φ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)) x‖ ≤ (ρ + 1) * b
